public_summary: During demo validation the executor refused a risk-floor check that carried a price several seconds old; the one-shot session fence stopped the run and no trade request was sent.
historical_context: The test harness had consumed an older state snapshot while a fresher one was available. The harness now waits for a fresh authenticated state with price age under five seconds before every case, with regression tests reproducing this failure. The fenced session was not reused.

evidence.tested_gate: fresh quote required for risk-floor probe
limitations: Protected operational evidence is withheld; this record states only the reviewed governance outcome.
Demo environment only; no broker order was submitted, so no execution outcome exists.
